blogs.title: The Butterfly Effect in AI: Making Giant Models Tiny to Train
blogs.description: Explore the core mathematical insight of the paper: how borrowing the 'butterfly' structure from Fast Fourier Transforms allows researchers to construct dense, powerful orthogonal matrices using far fewer trainable parameters. This post demystifies the concept of trading computation for space.

blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Why 'Orthogonal' Finetuning is a Stronger Contender
blogs.description: A comparative analysis of Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT) against popular methods like LoRA. We explain why preserving the pairwise angles between neurons (orthogonality) leads to better generalization and less catastrophic forgetting, and why this approach goes beyond just controlling text-to-image generation.

blogs.title: From Grids to Graphs: Visualizing How BOFT Transmits Information
blogs.description: Dive into the paper's unique 'Information Transmission' framework. This blog post uses visual diagrams of grid graphs to explain how factorizing a matrix into sparse components is equivalent to routing information through a network, making complex linear algebra intuitive.

blogs.title: No Extra Latency: The Secret Weapon for Real-Time LLM Adaptation
blogs.description: Focus on the practical implications for developers. While adapters and prompt tuning add layers or tokens during inference, model finetuning updates the weights directly without inference overhead. Learn why BOFT is a perfect fit for deploying robust LLMs in latency-sensitive applications.
